verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator: hardware plus its PyTorch, DeepSpeed and vLLM software stack. It is not an agent or application that acts as an MCP client and calls tools, so plugging in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
